next_action.action: Review PR #7, run the pinned PAM validators in a GitHub-capable/local environment, then close or explicitly retain the remaining preflight gaps before broad implementation.
next_action.acceptance: Project definition/scope/reuse decisions are accepted, PROJECT_ASSURANCE.json and HANDOFF_STATE.json validate against PAM, and remaining implementation-phase requirements are explicitly pending rather than falsely satisfied.

decisions_not_to_reverse: V0 is a small Applied AI/RAG vertical slice before broad curriculum expansion.
Game progression is not learner mastery evidence.
LLM reasoning evaluation does not override deterministic or dataset evidence.
Study OS remains the preferred longitudinal learner-evidence/capability authority.
PAM remains projectization methodology rather than a gameplay runtime dependency.
The general run bench is deferred until the small learning loop demonstrates value.
open_questions: Which exact RAG dataset/fixture and immutable revision should power the first dataset-backed mission?

What exact Study OS application contract should receive Interview OS attempt/evidence payloads?
Does the Expo visual interaction spike meet the desired Design Bakery-style game feel on both iOS- and Android-sized targets?

hidden_evaluation.policy: Agent-visible handoffs may reference hidden-evaluation policy and item classes but must never contain hidden answers, labels, seeds, private evaluator material, or protected transfer items.
